item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-10-27
item.description: ## 今日发生了什么 今天论坛的主要热度集中在 Fiber/Cashu 支付与入金路径：FiberNuts 提出资助提案，ckb-on-ramp 发布 testnet demo 并引发讨论 [S03, S05]。同时，CKB DEx 更新 README、UTXOPlay alpha 上线、Tactus 0.02 发文说明，几个项目都在推进 [S01, S11, S13]。钱包与身份侧，Pocket Node 发布 v1.8.6，Vellum 提交 M2 交付报告 [S08, S10]。整体看，今天不是单帖刷屏，而是支付、游戏、钱包和基础设施几条线同时有更新 [S03, S08, S11, S13]。 ## 重点话题 FiberNuts 提案请求 6000 美元等值 CKB，计划用 12 周开发验证 Cashu-over-Fiber 结算适配器，并让标准 Cashu mint 发行和赎回 RUSD 计价的 ecash [S03]。有回复称赞文档和 KPI，并提出一对一沟通 [S04]。 ckb-on-ramp 发布 testnet demo，目标是让只有 BTC 闪电钱包的新用户不装软件、打开网页就把 BTC 换成 Fiber 通道资产 [S05]。讨论认为若路径跑通，Fiber 可能成为进入 CKB 生态的第一站，并提到 fiber-js WASM、Passkey 和 LSP 商业模式 [S06]。还有回复指出 ckbolt 有类似 demo，并称自己的 ckbolt demo 可能当天或次日上线 [S07]。 CKB DEx 进度更新中，LucentLabs 表示已更新...

item.title: Ever wanted to customize your connect wallet? (1 posts)
item.description: Great work, Victor! I’ve been building several projects in the CKB ecosystem, including SkillPass, CellFlow, and CellGuard, and I think having a more flexible wallet connection UI is really useful for improving the user experience. I especially like how this builds on the existing CCC provider while allowing developers to customize the wallet list, connection flow, and account layout without being locked into a predefined interface. The optional did integration is also a nice touch! This could be particularly useful for SkillPass, where I want the wallet connection experience to feel like a natural part of the application rather than a separate blockchain interaction. item.title: [DIS] FiberNuts: Reliable Cashu-over-Fiber Payments with Hosted-LSP Onboarding (2 posts)
item.description: Summary This proposal requests $6,000 USD equivalent in CKB for a 12-week development and validation phase for FiberNuts, an open Cashu-over-Fiber settlement adapter with RUSD reference applications. FiberNuts lets a stock Cashu mint issue and redeem RUSD-denominated ecash through Fiber Network. Users can add ecash by paying a Fiber invoice, transfer Cashu tokens directly, settle received tokens by swapping them for fresh proofs, and cash out through an external Fiber invoice. The mint remains custodial and controls issuance, swaps, and redemption. The protocol already works. item.description: 最近我做了一个小 demo，叫 ckb-on-ramp，线上测试版在 https://onramp.retric.uk （全部跑在 testnet）。它要回答的问题是：一个手里只有 BTC 闪电钱包、没有 CKB 的新用户，能不能不装任何软件，打开网页就把 BTC 换成 Fiber 通道里的资产？ 我觉得这个想法有意思，是想到如果有这样一个产品，不仅能解决入金问题，也能通过通道网络，让新用户从第一天开始就感受到CKB上二层网络的魅力。onboarding 不一定要 onboard 到 CKB 网络的一层里，二层也许是个更实用的选择。比如入金之后，用户可以直接就去做小额快速的支付，或是直接玩fiber上的游戏。这或许能打开不一样的应用场景。 image2880×1556 241 KB d82c8b602d0f7b745c8c36d18fa7006a2880×1556 210 KB c52a3d4cab2dc13d3b88ed4d9bcd6cb72880×1556 197 KB 7e1015b4b89d4c72c24fc89a6acc16021170×2532 77.7 KB 我自己尝试了下用了zeus 钱包来扫描 demo 里的二维码，换了一点 CKB testnet 上的 cWBTC 的token，体验还是挺有意思的。 这篇帖子简单写下这个 demo 是怎么实现的、我想验证什么、有哪些限制，以及我觉得 Fiber 可以在协议层补上的几项能力。 一、这个 demo 有趣在哪 我觉得有意思的地方有三点。 用户的 Fiber 节点跑在浏览器里。前端用 fiber-...

item.title: Tactus O1: First Based EVM Rollup on CKB (1 posts)
item.description: Tactus 0.02 — making the rollup lifecycle explicit Tactus 0.01 explored whether an EVM rollup on CKB could work. In 0.02, the focus is making the different parts agree: how transactions enter the system, what order they follow, when their results can be trusted, and what users can do if progress stops. The most important distinction is between being ordered and being settled. A transaction appearing in the rollup’s history does not, by itself, make its result available for withdrawals. flowchart LR A[Request accepted] --> B[Order recorded on CKB] B --> C[Execution checked] C -. item.title: Twine is up. Try buying and selling CKB without an exchange using Fiber and Nostr (2 posts)
item.description: GTBank is only a payment method on this test desk, for NGN. There is no integration and no relationship with the bank. Zelle is the same kind of label for USD. A coordinator sets the methods on their own desk, for whatever currency they want to support. Twine never talks to the bank. The buyer pays the account the seller types into that trade. Verifying that payment with the bank is not something this can do. The rules are different in every country, and many banks will not allow that kind of check.
